newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - June 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - June 30.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Entry of Chinese troops in Hong Kong marks an end to British colonisation in Asia. Chinese authorities pledge to organise a democratic local election in May 1998.
-- A bailout of insurer GAN, for which the former conservative government promised a 20 billion franc recapitalisation, may require an alliance with a private sector partner.
-- French Banking Commission report highlights competitive distortions in the banking sector, notably when loans are offered at a loss, and calls for structural reforms.
-- A four percent rise in the minimum wage from July 1 will have the greatest impact in the services, textile and construction sectors.
